scope: Final product-polish pass. No new subsystem, no architectural redesign. Two trust gaps closed, the human-facing report reordered, and every public claim re-audited against what is implemented.

workstreams.name: Deontic support gate
workstreams.summary: A directly-stated candidate may auto-promote to a binding force only where the modal language of its own cited sentences supports one.

items.desc: src/validation/deonticSupport.ts — deterministic, sentence-scoped lexical modality classifier (BINDING_POSITIVE / BINDING_NEGATIVE / BINDING_RESTRICTIVE / ADVISORY / MIXED / NONE)
Gate applied at the single warrant choke point (checkWarrant), so all three proposal paths are covered and none can bypass it
Advisory-only evidence REJECTED for a binding claim; no-modal / mixed / wrong-polarity evidence HELD FOR REVIEW; advisory candidates not gated at all
Optional forceEvidence: a second quote resolved and verified to the identical standard, which cannot rescue an advisory primary span
23 adversarial tests (test/deonticSupport.test.ts) + two RecourseBench properties against real sources (UMN, Buffalo)
Limits stated rather than hidden: this is lexical modality, not entailment; a binding sentence about a different obligation still satisfies the gate

workstreams.name: Exception / waiver semantics
workstreams.summary: CWRU's notice provision carries an explicit respondent waiver in the same list item. A deterministic NONCONFORMANT finding while that waiver is unresolved is no longer possible.

items.desc: ConformanceException on the conformance IR: description + establishedByEventType + negatedByEventType + its own verified warrant
Four distinguishable states: CONFORMANT / NONCONFORMANT / EXCEPTION_APPLIES / UNDETERMINED, with exception state NOT_APPLICABLE / APPLIES / EXCLUDED / UNRESOLVED
Absence of a waiver event is never read as evidence that no waiver occurred; negatedByEventType is required so there is always an affirmative route back to a violation finding
An unverifiable or inferred waiver is rejected, never dropped back to 'no exception'
10 tests (test/exceptions.test.ts) + four RecourseBench properties on the live CWRU capture
The relevant-information lead time is a separate list item the waiver does not reach, and remains the clean flagship NONCONFORMANT

Summary leads: governing procedure, what it required, what happened, the finding + exception state, both parties' deadlines, forecast implication, what could not be determined, explicit 'no remedy or outcome is inferred'
Hashes, spans, warrants, refused claims and full computation moved below an 'Evidence and working' divider — moved, not dropped
Ordering enforced by test: no content hash may appear before the first finding
TRACE_VERSION 2; new UNRESOLVED_EXCEPTION uncertainty kind; trace-hash statement corrected to content-addressed-for-a-captured-analysis
Grok Skill Step 7 rewritten to the same response shape
